Diploma · font

Print: A4, scale 100 %, margins “none”. Best on heavy ivory paper. Page 1 = left, page 2 = right, page 3 = cover suggestion.

PRO AMORE ET FELICITATE
MMXXVI
THE ROYAL ACADEMY
OF ARRANGED AFFINITIES
has decided to award
Antje Küchler
the 2026 Nobel Prize in Matchmaking
for her pioneering discoveries in matchmaking,
in particular for demonstrating that two hearts,
under the right conditions, form a stable compound
Moritzholm, 10 December 2026
Permanent Secretary
wax seal here
Vita Somnium Breve
Chair of the Committee
for Matchmaking

Cover – suggestion

The case that holds pages 1 and 2. Nothing ordered, nothing produced.

THE NOBEL PRIZE
IN MATCHMAKING
Front
Doc’s VSB seal (Yggdrasil, “Vita Somnium Breve”) in gold, slightly embossed, in the upper half – it echoes the wax seal on page 2. Near the bottom edge “THE NOBEL PRIZE / IN MATCHMAKING” in small gold capitals, both lines exactly the same width. Nothing else.
Colour and material
Burgundy, like the real medicine covers and Antje’s red medal case. Goatskin-look leather or fine bookcloth; lettering and seal hot-foil stamped in gold, no frame. Alternative: midnight navy to match the reading folder.
Format and inside
A hinged case, approx. 22 × 31 cm closed; inside, page 1 left and page 2 right, mounted flat. Ivory endpapers.

The real ones (verified): since 2016 the bookbinder Leonard Gustafssons Bokbinderi has made every diploma cover; “The Nobel Prize” is stamped in gold on the cover, and the calligraphers design a personal gold monogram for each laureate on the outside, repeated on the box. Medicine covers are burgundy goatskin.

Back cover – suggestion

Same bordeaux and gold embossing as the front. Nothing ordered, nothing produced.

THINK THE IMPOSSIBLE
REGIA ACADEMIA ATTRACTIONUM CONCILIATARUM·KÖNIGLICHE AKADEMIE DER VERMITTELTEN ANZIEHUNGEN
Top
Doc’s motto “THINK THE IMPOSSIBLE” in one line, 22 mm from the top edge – mirroring the front title, which sits 22 mm from the bottom.
Bottom
The academy in Latin, a round middle dot, then in German – again both lines the same width.
Finish
Gold hot-foil stamping like the front, no frame, no emblem. Seen from the back, the spine is on the right.
